name: hanimdl
description: Standalone CLI downloader for Hidive with VTT-to-ASS subtitle conversion
author: cornsnaker

scripts.build-windows-x64-cli: npm run prebuild-cli && cd lib && node modules/build windows-x64
scripts.build-windows-arm64-cli: npm run prebuild-cli && cd lib && node modules/build windows-arm64
scripts.build-linux-x64-cli: npm run prebuild-cli && cd lib && node modules/build linuxstatic-x64
scripts.build-linux-arm64-cli: npm run prebuild-cli && cd lib && node modules/build linuxstatic-arm64
scripts.build-macos-x64-cli: npm run prebuild-cli && cd lib && node modules/build macos-x64
scripts.build-macos-arm64-cli: npm run prebuild-cli && cd lib && node modules/build macos-arm64
scripts.build-alpine-x64-cli: npm run prebuild-cli && cd lib && node modules/build alpine-x64
scripts.build-alpine-arm64-cli: npm run prebuild-cli && cd lib && node modules/build alpine-arm64
